Row.Text: Move the selected unit one tile at a time with the number pad. The keys can be changed in Options.

The key that moves the selected unit one tile this way, as a right-click on that tile would. "Move up" and "Move down" step between the two upper or lower tiles in turn, so the unit travels straight up or down the map. While a route key is held, this key moves the route marker instead.

Hold this key and press the direction keys to walk a marker across the map from the selected unit. The game draws the path and turn count as you go. Release the key and the unit is sent there, as a right-click on that tile would; Escape while holding drops the route.
A second key for planning a route, so either hand can hold it. Works exactly like the first.

The game's own Cancel action, the button that appears while a unit is carrying out an order: the unit stops where it is and waits for a new order. The key does nothing when the unit has no order to cancel.
Shift (on Windows, also pans the camera)
